'''Corellian Engineering Corporation decks''' are constructed lists published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site (CollegePark/Plaza/9433 and later plarathas). The surviving index listed the same five titles from 9 July 2000 through the 2009 Yahoo shutdown. Classic Dark Side stayed empty on every capture; Wayback did not keep extra Light or Dark files beyond these five.

Classic Star Wars lists keep the published title, the author handle, the card list, and a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download. [[Young Jedi]] lists are a different Decipher game.

A parent index of all published 60s is [[Decklists]].
